A1.justification: Both complete, readable PDFs describe EAG3R and include the main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A.1-A.10. All material supports reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original depth estimation, camera pose, reconstruction, and ablation results in Section 4, with additional generalization, efficiency, and repeated-run results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and results, including the MVSEC and M3ED evaluations and four-run statistical analysis.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same Retinex enhancement, event adapter, SNR-aware fusion, and event-based global optimization. No algorithm, architecture, objective, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions include ETartanAir pretraining, MVSEC day-to-night evaluations, and Appendix A.7's MVSEC indoor and M3ED robot/drone scenarios. Dataset, task, and environmental coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain identical comparator sets, including DUSt3R, MonST3R, their enhancement/fine-tuning variants, Easi3R variants, and appendix design alternatives.

E3.justification: Training budgets, splits, preprocessing, metrics, and testing procedures are unchanged. Both specify 25 fine-tuning epochs with 8,000 pairs per epoch and the same daytime-training/nighttime-testing protocol.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 3, enhancement/adapter/fusion/feature-selection analyses in Tables A.3-A.6, reconstruction examples, and runtime/scalability analyses are already present in v1 and retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both Appendix A.8 and Table A.13 report four independent training runs with the same means, standard deviations, and p-values. Statistical reporting and repeated-run information are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match across the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains EAG3R's Night3 Abs Rel of 0.288, and Table A.10 retains its M3ED robot-dog ATE of 0.1361.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(10), their assumptions and derivations, and the dataset-processing mathematics in Appendix A.1 are identical. No formal definitions, proofs, or mathematical reasoning are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, multimodal reconstruction, and zero-shot nighttime performance claims.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations are unchanged. Appendix A.9 retains the same limitations concerning dataset scarcity, event quality/alignment, and instability with synthetic events.

D1.justification: Implementation settings and hardware in Section 4.1, preprocessing instructions in Appendix A.1, and computational details in Appendix A.6 are identical. No code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The same 79 works and research positioning are retained. Preprint-to-conference updates, revised author metadata, and the exchanged VGGT/VGGsfM reference numbers concern the same cited works.

P1.justification: v2 updates bibliographic venues, years, page ranges, author lists, and title capitalization, with corresponding citation renumbering and a new version stamp. The scientific prose and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Expanded bibliographic entries change line wrapping and move references across pages 12-15. All scientific figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 provides bibliographic maintenance while retaining the complete method, experimental evidence, statistical analyses, explanations, and limitations. The metadata updates and limited reference-page reflow do not materially change the paper's overall clarity, evidential strength, or reproducibility.
